mechanism_families.name: inline conditional invalidation/delete/quarantine at rejected request read
mechanism_families.race_boundary: A delete would require re-read/row lock or exact CAS against the observed physical row. Unconditional PK delete is forbidden because it can erase a concurrently published valid row.
mechanism_families.storage_degradation_preserved: possible but requires new request-write failure classification so repair failure cannot break safe fallback
mechanism_families.minimal_scope: bundle store + Hyperdrive/request capability + request tests + DB concurrency tests; likely capability/docs impact
mechanism_families.reason: The current localization request capability is explicitly read-only and has no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE. Moving repair writes into public request execution would broaden runtime privilege/design into the Stage 6 boundary and add write-failure semantics to an otherwise safe read miss.

mechanism_families.name: request-triggered durable rebuild/write from non-provider sources
mechanism_families.race_boundary: Must lock or condition the write so a stale rebuild cannot overwrite a concurrent current publication.
mechanism_families.storage_degradation_preserved: requires request-write failure handling and must keep fallback independent of repair success
mechanism_families.minimal_scope: resource loader, request context/Hyperdrive capability, bundle writer, raw-source policy context, tests and likely runtime-capability docs
mechanism_families.reason: Broader than deletion and still requires request write privilege. More importantly, current request raw machine source has no required generationPolicyVersion while publication compilation does; rebuilding durably from the request path would need additional policy context to avoid persisting an obsolete-policy machine value.

mechanism_families.name: separate local/CI reconciliation command outside request execution
mechanism_families.selected_submechanism: conditional locked delete-only reconciliation; do not rebuild
mechanism_families.race_boundary: Enumerate bundle identities, then for each identity open a short transaction, SELECT the current row FOR UPDATE, verify that locked/latest row with the existing verifyPersistedCompiledBundle, and DELETE only if that same locked row is still rejected. If publication wins first, FOR UPDATE returns the updated row and it is reverified/preserved. If reconciliation locks first, publication waits; deletion commits before publication upserts the new valid row.
mechanism_families.minimal_scope: bundle-store reconciler + database/publication concurrency tests + one explicit TypeScript CLI/package script; request loader/Hyperdrive code remains unchanged
mechanism_families.reason: Smallest mechanism that closes repeated durable rejection without widening request privileges, without selecting machine generation policy for a rebuild, and without Queue/Workflow/provider infrastructure.

selected_mechanism.name: local/CI locked invalid-bundle deletion reconciler
behavior: Use the existing current bundle verifier; never weaken verification and never duplicate a looser verifier.
Reconciliation is explicitly invoked outside request execution using a write-capable development/admin DATABASE_URL; it is not wired into the request Hyperdrive store.
Scan persisted bundle identities; process each identity in a short transaction.
Re-read the exact locale/namespace row with SELECT FOR UPDATE before deciding.
If the locked/latest row verifies as current, leave it untouched.
If and only if the locked/latest row throws PersistentBundleIntegrityError, delete that row in the same transaction.
Do not rebuild from raw translations and do not call any translation provider.

After deletion, ordinary requests see a normal bundle miss instead of repeatedly rejecting the same obsolete row; existing raw/local/English fallback remains unchanged. A later normal valid publication may repopulate the bundle.

concurrency_proof_basis.postgresql_17: SELECT FOR UPDATE blocks concurrent UPDATE/DELETE and, under Read Committed, waits for an existing updater then locks/returns the updated row or no row. This allows verification of the latest locked row before deletion.
concurrency_proof_basis.deadlock_note: The reconciler must lock only the bundle row and must not acquire translation generation-head locks or raw-translation locks. Publication may already hold generation-head locks and then wait for the bundle row, but the reconciler has no reverse dependency, avoiding a lock cycle.
